headline: Nifty soars 1.66% as *heavyweights lead* the charge
subline: Reliance and ICICI Bank were the key drivers amid mixed market performance.
hero_text: Nifty 50 surged 1.66% led by heavyweight gains, while the broader market saw mixed results with 899 advances against 1,755 declines.

why.title: Heavyweight Boost
why.desc: Reliance and ICICI Bank were key drivers.

why.title: Volatility Eased
why.desc: India VIX declined, reducing market tension.

sector_reasons.Private Bank: Gains led by ICICI Bank boost
sector_reasons.IT: TechM and others drove IT gains
sector_reasons.Financials: Rally helped by key financial stocks

bonus_text: Opposite directions as FIIs sold Rs 5,285.37 Cr and DIIs bought Rs 3,319.39 Cr.
movers_note_gainers: Key gains led by TechM and ICICI Bank.
movers_note_losers: Nestle was a major drag on the index.
watch_text: Tomorrow, focus on speeches by BOE Gov Bailey and Fed Chairman Warsh.
lessons: Heavyweight stocks like Reliance can drive the Nifty.
A decline in VIX suggests eased market tension.
FII outflows indicate potential market pressure.
Negative breadth points to a narrow-focused rally.
alert_text: Watch for BOE and Fed Chair speeches tomorrow at 11:30 IST and 13:00 IST.
cta_sub: Daily wrap every evening. Check back when the bell rings tomorrow.
next_text: Tomorrow's session may be influenced by key global speeches.
caption_a:
Nifty surged 1.66% driven by heavyweights like Reliance and ICICI Bank.
Volatility eased as India VIX fell by 4.1% to 14.03.
FIIs were net sellers, outflowing Rs 5,285.37 Cr.
Watch: BOE and Fed Chair speeches tomorrow.
